# TechXtrasol

> TechXtrasol is a software engineering company that designs, builds, deploys, and supports mission-critical digital systems for businesses in Kenya, Africa, and globally. We solve business problems using technology.

## Main Pages

- [Homepage](https://techxtrasol.tech): Company overview, services, and featured work
- [About](https://techxtrasol.tech/about): Our mission, vision, values, team, and locations
- [Pricing](https://techxtrasol.tech/pricing): Web development, maintenance, and digital marketing pricing
- [Blog](https://techxtrasol.tech/blog): Software engineering articles and tutorials

## Services

- Custom Software Development — ERP, HR, CRM, POS, healthcare, school management, SACCO systems
- Web Development — Corporate websites, portals, dashboards, PWAs, headless CMS
- Mobile App Development — iOS, Android, Flutter, cross-platform apps
- Enterprise Systems — Workflow automation, approval systems, multi-branch, RBAC, analytics
- Cloud Solutions — AWS, Azure, Docker, CI/CD, Linux, monitoring, high availability
- AI Solutions — Chatbots, document intelligence, RAG applications, LLM integrations
- API Development — REST, GraphQL, payment gateways, SSO, OAuth, biometric integration
- UI/UX Design — Wireframes, prototypes, design systems, Figma, accessibility

## Industries

- Finance & Fintech — Banking, M-Pesa, loans, SACCOs, payments
- Healthcare — Patient management, telemedicine, EHR, hospital systems
- Education — School management, LMS, online courses, student portals
- Retail & E-Commerce — Online stores, POS, inventory, multi-vendor
- Hospitality & Tourism — Booking platforms, hotel management, travel agencies
- Agriculture — Farm management, supply chain, IoT integration
- Government — Citizen services, document management, e-government
- Manufacturing — Production planning, quality control, supply chain
- Real Estate — Property management, tenant portals, lease management
- Logistics — Fleet management, delivery tracking, route optimization
- NGOs — Donation platforms, beneficiary tracking, grant management
- Startups — MVP development, rapid prototyping, scalable architecture

## Technology Stack

- Backend: Laravel, Go, Node.js
- Frontend: Vue.js, Nuxt, React, Next.js, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS
- Mobile: Flutter, Android
- Databases: MySQL, PostgreSQL, Redis, MongoDB
- Cloud: Docker, Linux, Nginx, Cloudflare, GitHub Actions
- AI: OpenAI, Ollama, Vector Databases, LangChain
- Design: Figma
